title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)

source.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), version not specified in EUDAT B2FIND metadata
source.rightsBoundary: EUDAT B2FIND records this exact ProBayes d-optimal record as CC-BY/openAccess. MouldMaster records that rights statement without inventing a CC-BY version and keeps the raw Parquet out of the repository.

experimentalContext.rowSemantics: one injection-moulded part / machine cycle per row, linked by MET_MachineCycleID; E77_MachineCycleCounter_global is also present
experimentalContext.qualityContext: All produced parts were manually inspected/classified; additional quality sources include scale, computer vision and infrared camera.

schemaInspection.commandsAndSetpoints: SET_* fields and DXP/DOS/DRY fields carrying Set/sv semantics are commands or set values and are not treated as direct measured waveform values.
schemaInspection.derivedAndAggregated: QUA area/max aggregates, E77 cycle aggregates and Mean-suffixed temperature-control fields are measured-derived summaries rather than raw waveform samples. Trigger, alarm, option and generic state fields are retained but excluded from physical-sample counting.
schemaInspection.labels: LBL_* fields include NOK, sink marks, sprue-circle, underfill, streak levels, old granulate and blowhole labels.
schemaInspection.unitsAndSemanticsReview: Source naming convention and data dictionary were reviewed by data-source family. EUROMAP77 and cycle-based fields carry documented physical semantics; vendor DataXplorer shorthand is retained without invented unit conversion. Generic vendor parameter/state fields remain bounded by their source semantics.

measurementBoundary.reasonSamplesNotYetAdded: The Parquet contains real physical time-series arrays, but MouldMaster does not add them to the scalar-sample ledger until per-channel time bases, lengths across every cycle, units and direct-measurement masks are normalized. Setpoints, triggers/states and aggregate features are therefore not accidentally counted as physical samples.
